text.text_excerpt: I've been day drinking here quite a few times and it's a rather pleasant place to hang out. Parking can get a little tricky, but if you're not afraid of walking a little bit, it isn't too bad. The layout is nice and cozy and I really like the barstool seating by the big open windows towards Jefferson Hwy. Sitting there by the window on a sunny day while drinking an ice cold Harp is very relaxing and enjoyable. Bartenders here are always friendly and helpful and will get you something for your thirst very quickly. A couple years ago we stopped in on St Patrick's day and food was provided and from what I remember (I wasn't THAT drunk yet), the food was delicious and made in their own kitche...

I have been to Holy Ground drunk, sober, bored, angry, and happy. The first time I went a friend and I were on our way to Bayou Bugaloo. There was a crotchety bartender there, some older guy. My friend said that was just kind of his demeanor, it's part of his (and THG) charm. Since then I've probably been back a half dozen times (I know...I should check in more!) It's never so crowded that you can't find a place to sit, which is nice. The beer is always cold, and they must keep their lines clean. I've never had a bad pour from this place. I really like the little kitchen in the back. The people are always friendly, and the selection of bar munchies is decent. They have darts and a pool ta...

This place was wonderful. Unsure of what time they open because their website said 2pm and 4 pm so we figured we would try. And they were open. Local place with cheap pours of Guinness. Very clean and interesting decor. Friendly bartender and friendly locals eating chili with flamin hot Cheetos. They do offer food but I think only for supper hours according to their menu. Loved our time here.
